reports.title: SI-BONE, Inc. Reports Financial Results for the Third Quarter 2026 and Reaffirms 2026 Revenue Guidance

guidance.heading: Updated Fiscal 2026 Outlook
section: SI-BONE reaffirms its previously issued 2026 worldwide revenue and gross margin guidance. Based on year to date operating expense trend the Company is reducing the operating expense growth expectation to 10.5%.

Updated (November 2, 2026) | Prior (August 3, 2026)
Revenue | $231M - $233M~15-16% growth | $231M - $233M~15-16% growth
Gross Margin | ~79.0% | ~79.0%
Operating Expenses | ~10.5% growthat revenue midpoint | ~12.0% growthat revenue midpoint
Adjusted EBITDA | Positive | Positive
